description: This Java source file defines the class HiveMqtt3ConsumerActor, which is an Akka actor responsible for receiving messages from an MQTT broker (specifically HiveMQ client MQTT v3) and forwarding them to a message processing actor within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity framework. The class includes methods to get MQTT message payload, topic, QoS, and to acknowledge messages.

classes.name: HiveMqtt3ConsumerActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for subscribing to MQTT v3 messages, processing them, and forwarding them to a message processing actor within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It handles MQTT message reception, payload extraction, QoS management, and message acknowledgment.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static method to create Akka Props configuration for this actor, taking connection details, message processor actor reference, source, dry-run flag, and MQTT specific config.

methods.name: getPublishMessageClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the MQTT publish message, which is Mqtt3Publish.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload from the MQTT message as an Optional ByteBuffer.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Returns the MQTT topic as a String from the message.

methods.name: getQoS
methods.description: Retrieves the Quality of Service level from the MQTT message.

methods.name: isRetain
methods.description: Checks whether the MQTT message has the retain flag set.

methods.name: sendPubAck
methods.description: Acknowledges the MQTT message to confirm reception.

methods.name: getEnforcementFilter
methods.description: Provides an enforcement filter based on message headers and topic, if available.
